synopsis: Queen Cleopatra lived significantly closer in time to the 1969 Moon landing than to the construction of Egypt's Great Pyramid.

title_card.title: Cleopatra lived closer to Moon landing.
title_card.subtitle: The Apollo landing occurred in 1969.

caption:
Cleopatra lived closer in time to the Moon landing than to the building of the Great Pyramid.

The Great Pyramid of Giza was constructed around 2560 BC, whereas Cleopatra ruled Egypt around 30 BC. When humans walked on the Moon in 1969, less time had elapsed since her reign than between her life and the pyramid's construction.
